navidi.title: Statistics for Engineers and Scientists
navidi.note: A reference book in the STA 115 course folder.

counting-techniques.why: Permutations and combinations with worked examples.

axiomatic-and-conditional-probability.read: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 (Basic Ideas; Conditional Probability and Independence)
axiomatic-and-conditional-probability.why: Axioms, the addition rule, conditional probability and independence.

total-probability-and-bayes-rule.why: Includes the law of total probability and Bayes' rule.

random-variables-expectation-and-joint-d.read: Sections 2.4 and 2.6 (Random Variables; Jointly Distributed Random Variables)
random-variables-expectation-and-joint-d.why: Expectation, variance and joint and marginal distributions.

discrete-distributions.read: Sections 4.1 to 4.4 (Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson and Some Other Discrete Distributions)
discrete-distributions.why: The discrete distributions in this topic, including the hypergeometric and geometric.

normal-distribution.why: Standardising and using the normal table.

sampling-distributions-and-estimation.read: Sections 4.9 and 4.11 (Some Principles of Point Estimation; The Central Limit Theorem)
sampling-distributions-and-estimation.why: Unbiased estimators and the sampling distribution of the mean.
